# Clinical Practice

Clinical practice around [[adhd|ADHD]] diagnosis and treatment in [[danmark|Danmark]] is documented through data drawn from [[adhd-databasen|ADHD-DATABASEN]], covering how diagnostic conferences are staffed, what treatment elements are actually delivered, and how they can (or cannot) be captured in registry data.

On the diagnostic side, the steering group behind ADHD-DATABASEN agrees that most diagnostic conferences involve participation of speciallæger (medical specialists) [^src1]. Some regions instead hold diagnostic conferences with a specialpsykolog (specialist psychologist) present, but this arrangement is not the majority pattern across the country [^src1]. Diagnosis itself rests first and foremost on the clinical picture and a careful anamnesis, gathered with participation from both the patient and the patient's close relatives [^src4]. As part of this process, clinicians ask about co-occurring psychiatric and somatic illness (comorbidity), and a psychological assessment of possible learning difficulties is often included [^src4].

On the treatment side, the picture is more constrained. Most conversations with patients include elements of individual psychoeducation, but in a format that does not meet the requirements of the data definitions used by the database — meaning this activity cannot actually be registered [^src2]. More broadly, ADHD-targeted psychotherapy is not offered to any significant extent in Danmark [^src3]. Taking the reported figures into account, medical (pharmacological) treatment stands out as the most frequently offered treatment modality within hospital-based psychiatry [^src4].

Together these claims describe a clinical practice landscape where diagnosis is specialist-driven and anamnesis-based, but where registered treatment options lag behind what actually happens in consultations — psychoeducation occurs informally but goes unrecorded, psychotherapy is largely absent, and medication dominates as the documented treatment path.

## Claims

**ADHD_2023.pdf, page 26** (source: wikis/rkkp-adhd/raw/ADHD_2023.pdf, pages 26-30)
- Der er enighed i styregruppen om, at størstedelen af diagnostiske konferencer sker med deltagelse af speciallæger [^src1] (adhd-databasen)
- Nogle regioner har diagnostiske konferencer med specialpsykolog, men det er ikke flertallet af konferencer [^src1] (adhd-databasen)

**ADHD_2024.pdf, page 41** (source: wikis/rkkp-adhd/raw/ADHD_2024.pdf, pages 41-45)
- Der i de fleste samtaler indgår elementer af især individuel psykoedukation, men dette i et format, der ikke lever op til kravene i datadefinitionerne og dermed ikke kan registreres [^src1] (adhd-databasen)

**ADHD_2024.pdf, page 46** (source: wikis/rkkp-adhd/raw/ADHD_2024.pdf, pages 46-50)
- Der tilbydes ikke i noget betydeligt omfang ADHD-rettet psykoterapi i Danmark [^src1] (danmark)

**ADHD_2024.pdf, page 56** (source: wikis/rkkp-adhd/raw/ADHD_2024.pdf, pages 56-60)
- Diagnosen stilles først og fremmest på det kliniske billede og en omhyggelig anamnese med deltagelse af patienten og patientens nære pårørende [^src1] (adhd)
- Der udspørges til samtidig anden psykiatrisk og somatisk sygdom (komorbiditet) og ofte indgår en psykologisk undersøgelse vedrørende eventuelle indlæringsvanskeligheder [^src1] (adhd)

**ADHD_2024.pdf, page 57** (source: wikis/rkkp-adhd/raw/ADHD_2024.pdf, pages 56-60)
- Tager man de opgivne tal i betragtning er medicinsk behandling den hyppigste behandlingsmodalitet som tilbydes i den hospitalsbaserede psykiatri [^src1] (adhd-databasen)
